subject: Q1 wrap: OKR scorecards, quick wins and action list
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q1 wrap: OKR scorecards, quick wins and action list

Team —

Attached are the initial Q1 OKR scorecards (q1_scorecards_v1.xlsx) and a short retro template (retro_notes_template.md). We need concise inputs from each owner: 1–2 sentence rationale for the score by objective and up to two bullets for the "what went well / what to improve" section.

Please do the following by EOD Monday (Apr 5):
- Fill the score & 1–2 sentence rationale in the scorecard row you own.
- Add at least one concrete follow-up we should carry into Q2 (owner + timeline).

Proposed 30-minute calibration: Tue Apr 6, 11:00–11:30 PT (calendar invite incoming). If that time absolutely won't work, flag alternate windows.

Notes for narrative: keep exec summary tight (3 bullets: top win, top gap, ask). I'll compile and draft the Q1 narrative doc after calibration.

Attachments: q1_scorecards_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), retro_notes_template.md (markdown)

Thanks —
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q1 wrap: OKR scorecards, quick wins and action list

On Fri, Apr 2, 2026 at 9:12 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Attached are the initial Q1 OKR scorecards...

Thanks Karthik — I've populated the scorecard for Product Growth objectives (see sheet "PG - Laura"). Quick notes:
- Objective PG-1 (hosted API adoption): Score 75/100 — strong trial conversion in Feb, but churned accounts from a single partner integration pulled numbers down. Rationale: conversion lifted by marketing + SDK improvements, retention hit by integration fragility.
- Objective PG-2 (latency SLO): Score 60/100 — we missed the SLO during the mid-March serving regression (incident #20260314-serve). Suggest adding an incident retro item: "reduce full-stack restore time to 45m".

I'll annotate the retro template with the incident timeline and a proposed owner (Ethan Park for infra follow-up).

Attachments referenced: none from me (I updated q1_scorecards_v1.xlsx directly).

Laura Bennett
VP, Product Growth
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q1 wrap: OKR scorecards, quick wins and action list

Karthik / team —

I reviewed the updated rows and have two high-level edits for the leadership narrative:
1) Call out revenue composition: Dedicated contracts were +28% QoQ (material to ARR), but Private deployments ramp slower than expected — tie that to the "sales engineering" objective where we underperformed.
2) Emphasize reliability work as the primary drag on product adoption in March (connects to Laura's latency note).

For scoring adjustments: I'm proposing +5 to the Dedicated revenue objective (marcus to confirm) and -7 to the Private deployment onboarding objective.

I'll put a short paragraph in the shared doc with suggested exec wording. If anyone has hard objections, reply here before Mon noon so I can fold changes into the draft.

Vivek
COO
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>

- Approve the adjusted numbers in v2 (I highlighted changes in yellow).
- Approve the draft incident retro item language (in v2 sheet "Infra Retro").

If we can lock this by end of Mon Apr 5 I will finalize the narrative draft for Tue's calibration. Otherwise, we'll need to push the exec summary timeline.
